intro: Nepali culture blends Hindu and Buddhist traditions, with countless festivals and temples.

chapters.title: Gods and goddesses
text: The Kumari, a girl worshipped as a living goddess, lives in Kathmandu. Pashupatinath and the Boudhanath stupa are holy sites. Nepal's flag is the only national flag that is not a rectangle.

chapters.title: Food
text: Dal bhat (lentils and rice) is eaten twice a day. Momos, steamed dumplings, are everywhere.
